oneLine: SEBI clears IPO documents of seven companies including Sterlite Electric and Nobel Hygiene.

sources.title: SEBI Clears IPO Documents of Seven Companies, Including Sterlite Electric and Nobel Hygiene, in November 2026

synopsis: Seven companies including Sterlite Electric, Beauty Garage, Nobel Hygiene, Gaurik Fashions, Emerald Jewel Industry India, MP Steel (India), and Kataria Dhulchand Pannalal Jewellers have received observations from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on their draft IPO documents in November 2026. Sterlite Electric, a Vedanta Group company, aims to raise around 1,500 crore rupees through a combination of a fresh issue and an offer for sale by existing shareholders including promoter Twins Star Overseas. Beauty Garage plans to raise up to 125 crore rupees through a fresh issue and an offer for sale by promoters Jigar Babubhai Ravaria and Mahesh Babubhai Ravaria. Nobel Hygiene plans to raise 150 crore rupees via a fresh issue and an offer for sale of 1.55 crore shares. MP Steel plans to raise 95 crore rupees alongside a promoter share sale. Other firms including Gaurik Fashions, Emerald Jewel Industry India, and Kataria Dhulchand Pannalal Jewellers have also outlined their respective fresh issues and offer for sales.
